meta.guide_tau: Level caption:  energy (NIST, or a measurement of the last 20 years where one exists) and measured lifetime (where one exists).
meta.notes: No level entry carries new data: the stable Ce isotopes have nuclear spin 0 (no hyperfine structure) and the lifetime papers could not be opened. The 32 transitions listed are lines between drawn levels for which NIST gives no A; the A values come from Curry 2009 (PDF from the NIST publication server, parsed as text) and are semi-empirical arc-intensity values with +-35 % stated uncertainty, likely biased high (see conflicts). Wavelengths in the labels are the air wavelengths printed in that table (from the unpublished Martin line list).
